{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year change in R&D expense scaled by lagged total assets, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating R&D investments may be more likely to create innovative products and experience future growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Debt Issuance Momentum", "construction": "Compute the 2-year change in debt issuance, scaled by lagged market capitalization, using Thomson Financial's SDC Platinum database from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with increasing debt issuance may be taking on more risk and pursuing profitable investments", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of quarterly inventory turnover over the past 5 years, using Compustat data from 1999 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with volatile inventory turnover may be experiencing operational inefficiencies and potential future distress", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Compute the 3-year growth rate of total employees, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing employee bases may be experiencing increasing demand and future revenue growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year autocorrelation of advertising expenses, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with persistent advertising investments may be building strong brand recognition and future customer loyalty", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Restructuring Charge Frequency", "construction": "Count the number of restructuring charges over the past 5 years, using Compustat data from 1999 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with frequent restructuring charges may be experiencing operational inefficiencies and potential future distress", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Related Party Transaction Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of related party transactions to total revenue over the past 2 years, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with high related party transaction ratios may be experiencing agency conflicts and potential future governance issues", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Expansion", "construction": "Compute the 3-year change in the number of geographic segments, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with expanding geographic segments may be experiencing increasing global demand and future revenue growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of customer concentration over the past 2 years, using Compustat data from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration risk may be experiencing potential future revenue volatility", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Sensitivity", "construction": "Compute the sensitivity of executive compensation to stock price performance over the past 3 years, using Thomson Financial's Executive Compensation database from 2002 to 2004", "rationale": "Firms with high executive compensation sensitivity may be experiencing strong corporate governance and future alignment of interests", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
